## Work unit

Unit id (`<alias>.<doctype>`, from `just contribute pick`) and kind:

## Verification

Paste the output of `just contribute verify <id>` (the RESULT line must be PASS).

## Exemplars (public court records)

For each exemplar: filer, case, docket number, source URL (also in `usage/SOURCE.md`).

## Previews

The `pr-preview` workflow comments one image per changed page of every committed `OUTPUT-<id>.typst.pdf` this PR changes: top row BEFORE | AFTER, bottom row CHANGES (red = removed, green = added) | the REAL FILED EXAMPLE page. The comment is replaced on every push, so it always shows the latest revision. Before you open the PR, run `just preview` (writes `.overlay/preview/`) and look at every image. Nothing to paste here.

## Open tier-2 findings and BLOCKED items

By page, from your overlay review. Write "none" if none.

## Disclosure

AI assistance used (agent and model), and confirmation that you looked at every rendered page. No sealed, private or client documents.
